data.summary: The `claude-code` directory is a self-contained scenario definition unit in an image-building system (`aio-config gen`), pairing a metadata descriptor (`scenario.toml`) with its Docker build fragment (`fragment.Dockerfile`). Together they declare and install the Claude Code CLI (installed binary name `claude`) into a layer image via mise's aqua backend, pinned to version 2.1.278. It is configuration/infrastructure packaging rather than application business logic.

file_insights.name: fragment.Dockerfile
file_insights.summary: Docker build fragment that installs the Claude Code CLI (anthropics/claude-code) globally through mise's aqua backend, pinned by an ARG version.
file_insights.source_summary: A short Dockerfile fragment containing `ARG CLAUDE_CODE_VERSION={{version}}` and a RUN step that globally installs claude-code via mise, lists it with `mise ls`, and runs a bash-based self-check. The remainder of the file is Chinese-language commentary on binary naming, backend selection, and licensing constraints.
file_insights.detailed_description: This fragment is consumed by the `aio-config gen` fragment-resolution pipeline to bake the Claude Code layer image. It declares a CLAUDE_CODE_VERSION build arg (templated from the scenario version) and runs `mise use -g claude-code@${CLAUDE_CODE_VERSION}` plus a `mise ls` verification and shell self-check. Comments document two key gotchas: the scenario id is `claude-code` but the installed binary is `claude`, and the aqua backend is preferred over `http:claude` for checksum verification, along with a licensing warning since Claude Code is closed-source commercial software.
responsibilities: Declare the pinned Claude Code version as a build argument
Install claude-code globally via the mise aqua backend
Flag licensing constraints for redistributed images

file_insights.name: scenario.toml
file_insights.summary: Scenario metadata file declaring the id, display name, description, category, installer, and version list for the Claude Code layer, consumed by `aio-config gen`.
file_insights.source_summary: TOML configuration with top-level keys id, name, description, category ("app"), installer ("mise"), and a `[[versions]]` table listing label 2.1.278 with version 2.1.278. All content is declarative metadata with no executable logic.
file_insights.detailed_description: This TOML file is the declarative entry point for the claude-code scenario: it identifies the scenario (`id = "claude-code"`, which must match the directory name), describes it, marks it as category `app` with installer `mise`, and pins version 2.1.278. The description also carries the licensing warning about distributing closed-source binaries via `make save`, plus notes on install location (/opt/mise/installs) and image size (~224MB).
responsibilities: Declare the scenario identifier matching the directory name
Pin the Claude Code version for reproducible builds
Surface licensing, install path, and image-size notes to users
